seoTitle: How to Enable SSH Access on Hostinger Hosting
metaDescription: Learn how to enable SSH access on Hostinger web hosting, generate SSH keys, and connect via terminal or PuTTY, even as a beginner.
intro: SSH access unlocks a lot more control over your Hostinger hosting, letting you manage files and run commands directly instead of relying only on the dashboard. This guide covers enabling SSH from your Hostinger panel, generating your keys, and connecting through a terminal or PuTTY.

steps.heading: Enable SSH in your Hostinger dashboard
steps.body: Find the SSH access setting in your hosting panel and turn it on for the account you want to manage this way.

steps.heading: Generate your SSH keys
steps.body: Create the SSH key pair you'll use to authenticate, keeping the private key safe and accessible only to you.

steps.heading: Connect using terminal or PuTTY
steps.body: Use a terminal on Mac or Linux, or PuTTY on Windows, to connect to your server with the SSH details Hostinger provides.

steps.heading: Confirm the connection works
steps.body: Log in and run a basic command to verify SSH access is functioning correctly before relying on it for development tasks.

faq.question: Do I need to be a developer to use SSH on Hostinger?
faq.answer: No, the setup is explained in a beginner-friendly way, though SSH is most useful for advanced file management and development tasks.

faq.question: What tool do I need to connect via SSH on Windows?
faq.answer: PuTTY is a common option for connecting to your Hostinger server via SSH on Windows.

faq.question: Is SSH access included with all Hostinger plans?
faq.answer: SSH access is available on web hosting, and you'll need to enable it in the dashboard before you can connect.

faq.question: Why would I want SSH access instead of the file manager?
faq.answer: SSH gives you more direct, flexible control for command execution and advanced file management compared to the web-based file manager.
